name: Skills Manager
description: Installs and syncs agent skills across 50+ coding tools from a desktop app and an agent-friendly CLI.

skills.name: Browse marketplace
skills.description: Browses popular skills in the built-in marketplace and finds them with keyword search before installing.

skills.name: Track updates
skills.description: Checks Git-based skills for upstream updates and re-imports local ones, so every tool gets the latest copy.
